设计意图： Preserves the core mechanism of lagged return amplified by log volume ratio. Adds a lightweight regime adaptation: in high residual volatility states, a shorter ATR window (10) is used to adjust the volatility scaling, making the factor more responsive to recent volatility spikes; in low residual volatility, a longer ATR window (20) provides stable scaling. 📐 因子表达式 DSL (FactorEngine)

-(ewm_mean(5, (close/ts_delay(close, 5)-1) * log(volume/ewm_mean(volume, 30)) * np.where(resvol_high, ATR10/close, ATR20/close)))
已转 FactorEngine（真实 DSL，parse_expr 验证通过）

🧮 计算步骤（通俗版，已合并重复/中间变量）

  1. 1. ts_ema —— 指数移动平均
    ts_ema(multiply(multiply(subtract(divide(AdjClose, ts_delay(AdjClose, 5)), 1), log(divide(Volume, ts_ema(Volume, 30)))), where((ts_std(ts_pct(AdjClose, 1), 20) > 0), divide(ts_mean((AdjHigh true_range AdjLow true_range AdjClose), 10), AdjClose), divide(ts_mean((AdjHigh true_range AdjLow true_range AdjClose), 20), AdjClose))), 5)
  2. 2. multiply —— 乘法
    multiply(multiply(subtract(divide(AdjClose, ts_delay(AdjClose, 5)), 1), log(divide(Volume, ts_ema(Volume, 30)))), where((ts_std(ts_pct(AdjClose, 1), 20) > 0), divide(ts_mean((AdjHigh true_range AdjLow true_range AdjClose), 10), AdjClose), divide(ts_mean((AdjHigh true_range AdjLow true_range AdjClose), 20), AdjClose)))
  3. 3. multiply —— 乘法
    multiply(subtract(divide(AdjClose, ts_delay(AdjClose, 5)), 1), log(divide(Volume, ts_ema(Volume, 30))))
  4. 4. subtract —— 减法
    subtract(divide(AdjClose, ts_delay(AdjClose, 5)), 1)
  5. 5. divide —— 除法(自动防除零)
    divide(AdjClose, ts_delay(AdjClose, 5))
  6. 6. ts_delay —— 滞后 N 天(取N天前值)
    ts_delay(AdjClose, 5)
  7. 7. log —— 取自然对数
    log(divide(Volume, ts_ema(Volume, 30)))
  8. 8. divide —— 除法(自动防除零)
    divide(Volume, ts_ema(Volume, 30))
  9. 9. ts_ema —— 指数移动平均
    ts_ema(Volume, 30)
  10. 10. where —— 条件选择/防除零保护
    where((ts_std(ts_pct(AdjClose, 1), 20) > 0), divide(ts_mean((AdjHigh true_range AdjLow true_range AdjClose), 10), AdjClose), divide(ts_mean((AdjHigh true_range AdjLow true_range AdjClose), 20), AdjClose))
  11. 11. ts_std —— 过去 N 天滚动标准差
    ts_std(ts_pct(AdjClose, 1), 20)
  12. 12. ts_pct —— 过去 N 天变化率
    ts_pct(AdjClose, 1)
  13. 13. divide —— 除法(自动防除零)
    divide(ts_mean((AdjHigh true_range AdjLow true_range AdjClose), 10), AdjClose)
  14. 14. ts_mean —— 过去 N 天滚动平均
    ts_mean((AdjHigh true_range AdjLow true_range AdjClose), 10)
  15. 15. divide —— 除法(自动防除零)
    divide(ts_mean((AdjHigh true_range AdjLow true_range AdjClose), 20), AdjClose)
  16. 16. ts_mean —— 过去 N 天滚动平均
    ts_mean((AdjHigh true_range AdjLow true_range AdjClose), 20)
使用字段：
列含义说明
AdjClose后复权收盘复权后的收盘价，动量/收益类计算常用

AdjLow后复权最低复权后的当日最低价

🔬 陌生算子/字段释义

算子/字段含义
true_range真实波幅 TR = max(H-L, |H-C|, |L-C|)
ts_eman 期指数移动平均（EWMA）
ts_pctd 期变化率：(x − x_shift(d)) / x_shift(d)

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 ret_5：close / close.shift(5) - 1
  2. 计算 ema_vol：volume.ewm(span=30, min_periods=30, adjust=False).mean()
  3. 计算 log_vol_ratio：np.log(volume / ema_vol)
  4. 计算 atr_short：talib.ATR(high, low, close, timeperiod=10)
  5. 计算 atr_long：talib.ATR(high, low, close, timeperiod=20)
  6. 计算 vol_adj_short：atr_short / close
  7. 计算 vol_adj_long：atr_long / close
  8. 计算 resvol_high：style_gate_resvol_high
  9. 计算 vol_adj：np.where(resvol_high > 0, vol_adj_short, vol_adj_long)
  10. 计算 raw：ret_5 * log_vol_ratio * vol_adj
  11. 计算 factor：raw.ewm(span=5, min_periods=5, adjust=False).mean()
⚠ 该因子原始 IC 为负，已整体取反（×(-1)）调正方向；下列步骤展示的是原始公式的计算过程。

🔍 公式逐行拆解（算子释义）

  1. shift(close,5) — shift(n) → 滞后/移位
  2. MA30(volume) — MA30(x) → 30 期均线
  3. where(resvol_high, ATR10/close, ATR20/close) — where(cond, x, y) → 条件选择

🐍 原始 Python 代码 (factor_delivery)

"kw">class="kw">def factor_lag_volatility_regime_adapted(df): df_copy = df.copy() ret_5 = df_copy["close"] / df_copy["close"].shift(5) - 1 ema_vol = df_copy["volume"].ewm(span=30, min_periods=30, adjust="kw">class="kw">False).mean() log_vol_ratio = np.log(df_copy["volume"] / ema_vol.replace(0, np.nan)) atr_short = talib.ATR(df_copy["high"], df_copy["low"], df_copy["close"], timeperiod=10) atr_long = talib.ATR(df_copy["high"], df_copy["low"], df_copy["close"], timeperiod=20) vol_adj_short = atr_short / df_copy["close"].replace(0, np.nan) vol_adj_long = atr_long / df_copy["close"].replace(0, np.nan) resvol_high = df_copy["style_gate_resvol_high"] vol_adj = np.where(resvol_high > 0, vol_adj_short, vol_adj_long) raw = ret_5 * log_vol_ratio * vol_adj factor = raw.ewm(span=5, min_periods=5, adjust="kw">class="kw">False).mean() df_copy["factor_lag_volatility_regime_adapted"] = factor "kw">class="kw">return df_copy["factor_lag_volatility_regime_adapted"]
